title: Create StockChartPanel with period selector and indicator toggles
description: Create the main StockChartPanel container component that provides a complete stock chart experience: stock code input, period switching (daily/weekly/monthly), indicator toggle buttons (MACD/KDJ/BOLL/VOL), and integrates KLineChart component. Manages data fetching state.

files.change: Create full stock chart panel with toolbar (code input, period tabs, indicator toggles) and KLineChart area
Add StockChartPanel export to barrel file

implementation: Create StockChartPanel.tsx with StockChartPanelProps: defaultCode?: string, className?: string
Implement internal state: code (string), period (StockChartPeriod), enabledIndicators (Set<StockChartIndicator>), chartData (StockChartKlineItem[]), isLoading, error
Build toolbar section with: stock code input field, period tab group (日K/周K/月K), indicator toggle buttons (MACD, KDJ, BOLL, VOL) using Badge component for toggles
Implement fetchKlineData callback: call stockChartApi.getKlineData({code, period, startDate, endDate}), update chartData state
Auto-fetch data when code or period changes (useEffect), with debounce on code input
Render KLineChart component with chartData and enabledIndicators, show loading spinner and error states using existing Card/Badge/Loading patterns

reference.pattern: Container component pattern from StrategyBacktestPage.tsx (form state + API calls + error handling)
reference.examples: Follow StrategyBacktestPage.tsx state management pattern: useState for form + loading + error, async fetch with try/catch

criteria: StockChartPanel renders stock code input, period tabs (日K/周K/月K), indicator toggle buttons (MACD/KDJ/BOLL/VOL)
Period switching triggers data re-fetch and chart re-render
Indicator toggles add/remove chart overlays and sub-panes
Loading state shows spinner (consistent with StrategyBacktestPage pattern)
